prompt:
[TASK]
Draw one options window in exactly the visual language of reference image 1, at the size and layout of the previous version, but with the chrome corrected to match reference image 2 part for part: thinner lettering, the real tab strip, the real checkbox, the real title alignment and the real close button.

[REFERENCE ROLE]
Reference image 1 is the whole source window: palette, window border, title bar glass, panel, striped margin, raster character. Reference image 2 is a magnified parts sheet cut from that same window — the title bead and title lettering, the close button, the tab strip, the empty and ticked checkbox, the dropdown button, the blue-grey label face and the black body face — enlarged so their exact anatomy is visible. Copy those parts from it faithfully. Reference image 2 is a parts sheet, never a layout: do not draw it, do not arrange anything the way it is arranged, do not repeat a part more than the design calls for, and do not copy the Japanese or English words on it.

[PRESERVATION INVARIANTS]
- LETTERING IS THIN. Every glyph is a light-weight bitmap letter with strokes about two pixels wide at native scale, as in the parts sheet. Nothing is bold, heavy, fat or chunky. Letters are noticeably smaller than the controls beside them: a label's cap height is roughly half the height of its checkbox, not the full height.
- THE CHECKBOX is a plain square with a flat, even mid-grey #a6a6a6 frame about two pixels thick and no white bevel highlight. Its interior is a soft blurred gradient, slightly darker grey at the top-left fading to near-white at the bottom-right — never a flat fill, never a crisp inset bevel.
- THE TICK is a soft, blurred, painterly slate-blue mark, roughly #6b7c9e, thick in the middle and tapering, rising to the top-right and slightly overrunning the box edge. It is not a crisp vector check and not a bright saturated blue.
- THE TAB STRIP is narrow — each tab is barely wider than its rotated text. The active tab is plain white, flush against the panel, with NO drawn box around it: only a thin light-grey vertical rule down its outer side. The inactive tab is a pale lavender-white #f5f2f6 shape with a light grey outline whose corners are STAIR-STEPPED into small square notches, set lower and further left than the active tab, its text in thin mid-grey #8b898c.
- THE TITLE lettering is thin black with the white highlight offset up and to the LEFT of each stroke, not a halo wrapped all the way around. The text sits vertically centred in the bar with clear blue glass visible above and below it, and begins after a clear gap to the right of the bead.
- THE BEAD is a small blue sphere about half the bar's height, with a #5677b4 rim, a #779ae2 body and a pale #cbe1ef highlight band across its middle, floating with clear space above and below.
- THE CLOSE BUTTON is a small square with a near-black #413942 outer frame, a DUSTY ROSE interior — muted pink and mauve, not saturated red — and a pale, chunky, blocky X built from square pixel blocks with gaps in it.

[CANVAS AND LAYOUT]
- One window clearly taller than it is wide, at the same generous size and spacing as before: wide panel margins, a full clear line of white between every row.
- Order inside the panel, top to bottom: the search row, then the match row, then the ten material checkboxes as two columns of five.
- Two narrow vertical tabs on the left edge with text rotated ninety degrees counter-clockwise, reading bottom to top.
- A band of the striped margin runs down the left edge and along the bottom of the window.

[REGION EDITS]
- REGION: title bar
  CHANGE: The bar is reference image 1's pale sky-blue glass, #a5ccea to #b6d8f4 with the #cbe1ef sheen across the middle and right and the #fff5ff hairline along its top. At the left, the small bead sphere; after a clear gap, the title in the thin black lettering of the parts sheet with its white highlight offset up-left, vertically centred. At the right, the same bead again, then the dusty-rose close button.
  PRESERVE: clear blue glass above and below the title text; the gap between the bead and the first letter; the muted rose of the close button
- REGION: search row
  CHANGE: A left label in the thin blue-grey #2e4560 pixel face shown on the parts sheet. To its right a wide field with a #f9f3f7 interior inside a three-pixel #c5c3c6 sunken border, thin grey placeholder text at its left inside edge, and the parts sheet's dropdown button inset fully inside the field's right end: a pale bevelled square holding a wide downward triangle, pale blue across its top edge deepening to cornflower, with a dark navy outline and a small point at its base.
  PRESERVE: the dropdown button sitting inside the field border, not overlapping it; the thin light weight of both labels
- REGION: match row
  CHANGE: A left label in the thin blue-grey pixel face, then two checkbox-and-label pairs side by side with a wide gap between them: the first box carries the soft blurred slate-blue tick, the second is empty. Each label follows immediately beside its own box in the thin black body face. After both pairs, the closing phrase in the same thin black face. There is no slider, no track, no arrowhead and no round thumb anywhere in this image.
  PRESERVE: one ticked box and one empty box, both drawn exactly like the parts sheet; labels about half the height of their boxes
- REGION: ten material checkboxes
  CHANGE: Ten empty checkboxes in two columns of five, read down the left column first then down the right, generously spaced with a clear line of white between rows and the columns aligned on their box edges. Each label is the material name in the thin black body face, then its count in parentheses in a lighter grey of the same face, both noticeably smaller than the box.
  PRESERVE: identical box drawing on all ten; thin light lettering throughout; a clear line of white between every row
- REGION: left tab strip
  CHANGE: Two narrow tabs, each barely wider than its rotated text. The upper is active: plain white, flush to the panel, no box around it, only a thin light-grey rule down its outer side, text in thin dark charcoal. The lower is inactive: pale #f5f2f6, light grey outline with stair-stepped notched corners, set lower and further left, text in thin mid-grey.
  PRESERVE: the stair-stepped notches on the inactive tab; no drawn box around the active tab; how narrow both tabs are

[EXACT COPY]
- title bar: "Object type / material"
- active left tab: "object"
- inactive left tab: "material"
- search row label: "Search"
- search field placeholder: "Search"
- match row label: "Match"
- label beside the ticked box: "Any"
- label beside the empty box: "All"
- end of the match row: "selected filters."
- left column, row 1: "Metal (5,001)"
- left column, row 2: "Paper (3,652)"
- left column, row 3: "Glass (3,182)"
- left column, row 4: "Drawings (2,606)"
- left column, row 5: "Graphite (2,443)"
- right column, row 1: "Paintings (2,395)"
- right column, row 2: "Vessels (2,074)"
- right column, row 3: "Watercolors (1,962)"
- right column, row 4: "Wood (1,899)"
- right column, row 5: "Dishes (1,837)"

[STYLE SYSTEM]
- A screenshot of the very same early-2000s Japanese game client as reference image 1, showing a taller window of the same application.
- Hold the palette exactly: #ff00ff border with its #ff96ff bloom, #a5ccea to #b6d8f4 title glass, #ffffff panel, #f6f4f7 stripes, #f9f3f7 fields in #c5c3c6, #a6a6a6 checkbox frames, #6b7c9e ticks, #2e4560 label ink, thin black body text, #413942 and dusty rose on the close button.
- Everything is a low-resolution raster scaled up: soft blur inside the controls, hard stair-stepped glyph edges, no smoothing and no vector crispness.

[ASSET RULES]
- Exactly one window, one field with one dropdown button, twelve checkboxes total — one ticked and one empty in the match row, ten empty below — and two tabs.
- No logos, mascots, gauges, scrollbars, tooltips, extra panels or ornament.

[NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]
- Do not set any text in a bold, heavy or thick weight. No fat strokes, no letters as tall as their controls, no modern sans, no smooth antialiased type.
- Do not draw the checkbox with a white inset bevel, a flat even interior, or a crisp bright-blue vector tick.
- Do not draw a box, border or frame around the active tab, and do not make either tab wide or chunky.
- Do not wrap the title lettering in an even outline on all sides, and do not let the title fill the bar's height.
- Do not make the close button saturated red, orange or crimson, and do not give it a smooth thin X.
- No slider anywhere: no track, no trough, no arrowhead, no round thumb.
- Do not reproduce reference image 2 as a picture, do not lay parts out in a grid, and do not copy the words on it — no Japanese text, no BGM, Effect, Skin, on, opaque, attack, skill or item.
- Do not render the white background of the parts sheet as part of the window, and no white letterbox bars.
- Do not change, reorder, round or reformat any number; do not misspell Watercolors, Graphite or Vessels; do not add or drop a material.
- Do not tick any box except the one beside Any.

[QUALITY GATE]
- Held beside the parts sheet, the checkbox, the tick, the tabs, the title lettering, the bead and the close button read as the same artwork, not as redrawn lookalikes.
- No line of text is bold. Every label is clearly lighter and smaller than the control it sits beside.
- The active tab has no box around it and both tabs are narrow; the inactive tab's corners are visibly stair-stepped.
- The close button is dusty rose, not red, and its X is blocky with gaps.
- All ten material names and counts, plus Any, All and the row labels, are legible and exactly match the supplied strings.
- There is no slider in the image.
